result.summary: Found 3 issues: a major layout problem with horizontally clipped restaurant cards, a major functional issue with a stuck loading spinner blocking content, and a minor content truncation issue in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel clips the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right screen edge, cutting off the restaurant name and image mid-content with no visible scroll affordance or peeking indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a partial-card peek with a scroll hint (e.g., gradient fade or arrow) so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable, and ensure card text isn't abruptly cut off.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' shows a perpetual circular loading spinner overlaid on the center of the image, suggesting the image failed to finish loading or the spinner state is stuck, blocking the visual content.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading spinner is removed once the image loads; add a timeout/fallback state (placeholder image or error state) so the spinner never remains indefinitely over content.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated without an ellipsis, making the name appear broken rather than intentionally abbreviated.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis ('Trattoria Piccol…') or allow the name to wrap/resize within the card.
